obligations.statement: The product must be mountable on a wall.
The product must have a storage volume capable of holding about twenty small items.
A single actuation of the lever must release exactly one item.
A single actuation must never release more than one item.
The product must allow refilling from the top while remaining mounted on the wall.
The product must release an item without jamming when nearly empty.

candidates.summary: A gravity-fed dispenser with a lever-operated cam and single-item pocket.

evidence_route_verdict.note: The basic single-item release can be verified by mobility analysis.

candidates.summary: A gravity-fed dispenser with a lever-operated sliding gate that meters one item.

evidence_route_verdict.note: The gate motion and release cycle can be checked with mobility analysis.

candidates.summary: A spring-loaded dispenser with an indexing rotor that presents one item per actuation.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Indexing rotor release can be analyzed for motion constraints.

unresolved.decision: The release mechanism must ensure exactly one item per press, but the behavior when empty or nearly empty is undefined.
unresolved.why_open: The requirement 'exactly one' is ambiguous when the dispenser is empty or nearly empty; it might require a release or permit none, and the threshold for 'nearly empty' is unspecified.

assumptions.statement: The dispenser is operated manually by a single user.
assumptions.why: The requirement mentions 'I press a lever' implying manual operation.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: A specification that the dispenser is automated or operated by multiple users.

assumptions.statement: The small items are uniform in size.
assumptions.why: The requirement refers to 'small items' without variation, and dispensers typically handle uniform items.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: A specification that the dispenser must handle varied sizes or shapes.

assumptions.statement: The dispenser is intended for indoor use.
assumptions.why: Wall-mounted dispensers for small items are commonly indoor; no outdoor requirements are mentioned.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: A requirement for weather resistance or outdoor use.
